reason: It's free, so sure, I'd take the link once — and honestly the reader remembering where I stopped is the only part Discord doesn't already give me. The chat next to it is just Discord with extra steps.
objection: Discord plus a pinned shared-folder link already works fine for us, and now there's one more place to check that you might get bored of maintaining next month.
would_change_mind: If the reader is clunkier than the site we already use — slow loads, bad panel ordering on phone — I'm back in Discord within a week and not looking back.
